title: Okinawan language - Wikipedia
text: Central Okinawan distinguishes itself from the speech of Northern Okinawa, which is classified independently as the Kunigami language. Both languages are listed by UNESCO as endangered.

title: Okinawan language
text: The Okinawan language, specifically Central Okinawan, is classified as a member of the Northern Ryukyuan subgroup within the Ryukyuan branch of the Japonic language family.
